## 1. Purpose / Scope

This Solution Cost Input Template is designed to capture hosting, costing, and infrastructure requirements for ITO sizing and cost estimation. The following concerns should be addressed in this document:

1. `Define hosting model` and tenancy requirements with environment specifications
2. `Identify scalability metrics` including member counts, provider counts, and transaction volumes
3. `Specify compute and storage` sizing requirements and growth projections
4. `Specify disaster recovery` requirements with RTO, RPO, availability tier, and DR architecture type
5. `Document authentication` and security requirements including identity providers and VDI needs
6. `Capture networking` and connectivity requirements including bandwidth and connection types
7. `Identify data migration` volumes, sources, and timelines
8. `Detail environment scheduling` with required environments, sizing, and availability windows
9. `Identify third-party licensing` and monitoring requirements that affect infrastructure costs

[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/solution-cost-input-template.md#architecture-documentation]

### Architecture Documentation

At least one diagram is required. ITO uses these to identify infrastructure components, size environments, and estimate costs. Provide what exists — not all types are required for every solution.

| Diagram Type | Required | Location / Link |
| ------------ | -------- | --------------- |
| Infrastructure Topology | [ ] | [Compute, databases, storage, load balancers, and their relationships] |
| Network Flow | [ ] | [Connection paths, VPN/Direct Connect endpoints, bandwidth between entities] |
| Environment Topology | [ ] | [How non-prod environments map to prod — shared vs. isolated, sizing ratios] |
| Integration / Data Flow | [ ] | [External systems, APIs, file transfers, batch jobs, message queues] |

**Minimum requirement:** At least one diagram must show all infrastructure components that require hosting and their communication paths. Without this, ITO cannot produce a cost estimate.

### Availability Target

Select one:

- [ ] 99.0% (~3.65 days downtime/year) — Single AZ

- [ ] 99.95% (~4.38 hours downtime/year) — Multi-AZ with failover
